# Arduino UNO Q Dual-Brain Reference {.unnumbered}

The **Physical AI Kit** uses the **Arduino UNO Q** as the reference educational platform. This appendix provides the hardware specs, core partitioning, and inter-processor communication (IPC) contracts.


## Dual-Brain System Topology

| Processor Subsystem | Architectural Core and OS | Primary Systems Role and Execution Contract |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Application Processor (MPU)** | Multi-core ARM Cortex-A<br>Embedded Linux OS | **Untrusted Proposal Service:** Runs Python, PyTorch, ROS2, edge VLMs/VLAs; emits timestamped expiring trajectory proposals ($p_t$). |
| **Real-Time Controller (MCU)** | ARM Cortex-M / RISC-V<br>FreeRTOS / Bare-Metal | **Trusted Permission Authority:** Runs deterministic 1 kHz timing loop, dynamic stopping enforcer ($d_{\text{stop}}$), and hardware PWM timers. |
| **Inter-Processor Link (IPC)** | Shared SRAM Mailbox<br>RPMSG / OpenAMP Protocol | Zero-copy lock-free circular ring buffers with atomic sequence counters and hardware mailbox interrupts. |


## Hardware Resource Partitioning

| Subsystem | Application Processor (MPU) | Real-Time Controller (MCU) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Core Architecture** | Multi-core ARM Cortex-A | ARM Cortex-M / RISC-V |
| **Operating System** | Embedded Linux (Yocto / Debian) | FreeRTOS / Bare-Metal |
| **Memory** | 2 GB to 4 GB LPDDR4 DRAM | 256 KB to 512 KB SRAM |
| **Execution Domain** | Virtual memory, page tables | Physical addresses, zero paging |
| **Determinism** | Best-effort ($P_{99} \approx 20\text{--}80\text{ ms}$) | Hard real-time (Jitter $< 5\,\mu\text{s}$) |
| **Physical I/O** | USB, MIPI-CSI Camera, Wi-Fi / Ethernet | Direct Timer PWM, Encoders, E-Stop GPIO |


## Shared Memory RPMSG Message Contract

The MPU sends timestamped intent proposals to the MCU over the non-blocking RPMSG ring buffer.

```c
// Shared C Header for MPU and MCU: physical_agent_ipc.h

typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
 uint32_t message_id;
 uint64_t timestamp_us; // Microsecond hardware timestamp
 uint32_t lease_duration_ms; // Proposal expiration timeout
 
 // Target Spatial Goal (Cartesian in end-effector or world frame)
 float target_pos_x; // Meters
 float target_pos_y; // Meters
 float target_pos_z; // Meters
 
 // Trajectory Derivative Bounds
 float max_velocity_m_s; // Clamped velocity limit
 float max_acceleration_m_s2; // Clamped acceleration limit
 
 // Confidence and CRC
 float model_confidence; // [0.0, 1.0]
 uint32_t crc32; // Payload integrity checksum
} PhysicalAgent_IntentProposal_t;
```


## Hardware Safety Watchdog Protocol

The MCU monitors the MPU via a strict countdown watchdog:

1. **Heartbeat Packet:** MPU must transmit a ping packet every $\tau \le 10\text{ ms}$.
2. **Watchdog Timeout:** If MCU receives no heartbeat for $50\text{ ms}$, hardware timer triggers an NMI.
3. **Hardware Action:** MCU disables motor H-bridge power gate via GPIO pin `GPIO_PB12_ESTOP` within $250\,\mu\text{s}$.
